about: Overlay calls the approval.md CLASS-DIFF job (scripts/approval-class-diff.sh, .github/workflows/approval-class-diff.yml) lets resolve to a human-only class at the pinned core, or lets move from running to a deny when the pin moves. Read by approval.md's scripts/overlay-recipes-check.mjs: each entry is keyed by the recipe's file and its exact command text, carries the reason (Carter accepts a move by name), and may carry flip {from, to} to cover only that move. An entry no held recipe matches fails the job, so delete it when the recipe or the classifier moves.

entries.reason: OPEN, owner or Carter decides (EDGEOS-BLOCK sweep; approval-md#663 owner item 1; brief F3). Since core 0.4.6 (APRV-511, protected-path) the operator selfie recipe that names the Hermes home with --root classes policy.core, human-only under the template, so an agent following it is denied. Mirrors approval.md's own allowlist entry (scripts/overlay-recipes/allowlist.json). Delete it in the PR that changes the recipe or the rule: a stale entry fails this job.
